answer: Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a reef index of commitments rather than against the text alone. Because the island index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the oasis audit republishes the digest set at close. Filling 51 aliases hence needs 51 distinct prompts, so the operator pays the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
